description.narrative: The Action-based learning for Narrative Power project stimulates learning and innovation on narrative approaches through pilots in three countries. The pilots aim to shift harmful narratives related to shrinking civic space in their particular context. In Tunisia, the project will support diverse civil society partners to strengthen their narrative capacities and develop a narrative-based campaign strategy, building on their newly developed toolkit on hope-based narratives. In El Salvador, the project will convene spaces for youth to develop and disseminate alternative narratives on civic space and climate justice. In Myanmar, the project will supporta partner organization to adopt creative dissemination strategies for rights-based narratives. The experiences from the country pilots will support learning on narrative approaches across the confederation, especially around alliance building for narrative power, innovative approaches to disseminate narratives, and measuring narrative change. Given the potential for innovation and impact of narrative approaches, there is a need to invest in piloting and learning at country and regional level to test, adapt and refine approaches together with partners building on existing ongoing projects with civic space challenges.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
